summary: Cheche Group Inc., a Beijing-based insurance agency and brokerage, furnished a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, attaching unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2025 and June 30, 2026, plus management's discussion and analysis, incorporated by reference into existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. The filing covers the six months ended June 30, 2026 and discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. It is a routine foreign-private-issuer interim reporting update with no special-situation event; no risk-arb angle applies.
